# Plan: Nemotron-H Hybrid Inference on 12GB CUDA GPU

## 1. Tensor Offloading Strategy

The Nemotron-H architecture (as defined in `src/models/nemotron-h.cpp`) contains four tensor categories critical for latency-sensitive inference. The goal is to keep Mamba SSM, attention, router, and shared-expert tensors on the 12GB GPU while routing overflow experts to CPU RAM.

### Critical Tensor Mapping

| Tensor Category | GPU Tensors (Keep) | Overflow Target | Code Path |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Mamba SSM** | `ssm_in`, `ssm_conv1d`, `ssm_conv1d_b`, `ssm_dt_b`, `ssm_a`, `ssm_d`, `ssm_norm`, `ssm_out` | N/A (All fit on 12GB for typical H configurations) | `llama_model_nemotron_h::load_arch_tensors` (lines 68-95) |
| **Attention** | `attn_norm`, QKV weights (`create_tensor_qkv`), `wo`, `wo_b` | N/A | `llama_model_nemotron_h::load_arch_tensors` (lines 97-125) |
| **Router (MoE Gate)** | `ffn_gate_inp`, `ffn_exp_probs_b` | N/A | `llama_model_nemotron_h::load_arch_tensors` (lines 138-141) |
| **Shared Experts** | `ffn_down_shexp`, `ffn_up_shexp` | **CPU RAM** (Offload) | `llama_model_nemotron_h::load_arch_tensors` (lines 143-148) |
| **Routed Experts** | `ffn_down_exps`, `ffn_up_exps` | **CPU RAM** (Offload) | `llama_model_nemotron_h::load_arch_tensors` (lines 131-136) |

**Correctness Risk:** The `ffn_down_shexp` and `ffn_up_shexp` tensors must remain on GPU to avoid PCIe transfer overhead during the shared-expert routing phase. If these are offloaded to CPU, the latency benefit is negated
